description: Material list vectors (B38 R13, R15, R17). Rust `model_materials` and TypeScript `materialEntries` both read this file.
_note: Hex = three.js Color.setRGB(r, g, b, LinearSRGBColorSpace).getHexString(): each channel c becomes s = c < 0.0031308 ? 12.92 c : 1.055 c^0.41666 - 0.055, then round(clamp(255 s, 0, 255)). A VRM 0 color channel first gets c^2.2 (three-vrm v0compat gammaEOTF); the VRM 0 MToon alpha does not, the VRM 0 Unlit alpha does, after a clamp to 0-1. A VRM 0 outline width is 0.01 * _OutlineWidth. A VRM 0 _OutlineWidthMode of 0, 1, 2, "0", "1", or "2" gives a mode; another value gives none. The HDR emissive multiplier wins over KHR_materials_emissive_strength; a VRM 0 MToon strength is 1. Numbers are clamped: opacity 0-1, emissionStrength 0-100, outlineWidth 0-0.05.

cases.name: glTF PBR: base color, emission, and KHR_materials_emissive_strength; a material without factors takes the glTF defaults; strength is clamped to 100
unlit: only the base color applies
a BLEND material: opacity is the base color alpha; a MASK material does not blend

VRM 1 MToon: shade, rim, outline (worldCoordinates, 0.002), and the HDR emissive multiplier; mode none and width 0 give no outline; a wide outline is clamped to 0.05; KHR_materials_unlit does not change the profile
VRM 0 VRM/MToon: colors get pow(v, 2.2), the alpha stays linear, _OutlineWidth is multiplied by 0.01, _ALPHABLEND_ON blends; a material without properties takes the v0compat defaults
VRM 0 VRM/UnlitTransparent blends and its alpha also gets pow(v, 2.2); VRM_USE_GLTFSHADER reads the glTF material
emission strength: with both extensions, the HDR multiplier wins over KHR_materials_emissive_strength, for VRM 1 MToon and for glTF PBR
VRM 0 VRM/MToon with KHR_materials_emissive_strength on its glTF material: v0compat keeps only the MToon extension, so the strength is 1
VRM 0 VRM/UnlitTransparent: the alpha is clamped to 0-1 before pow(v, 2.2), so -0.5 gives 0 (not NaN) and 1.5 gives 1
VRM 0 _OutlineWidthMode: v0compat indexes the mode array with the raw value, so "1" and "2" give an outline like 1 and 2; "0", "x", 3, and 1.5 give none
duplicate names get a suffix in file order; an empty name is Material <index>
a 70-unit name is cut to 63 units, not through the surrogate pair at unit 64; its duplicate is cut to 60 units before the suffix
257 materials: the list keeps the first 256
